caption:
Turns out, the most efficient way to bypass security is to become part of the logistics chain. The foreman didn't care about my ID, just about who was going to carry his heavy grey crate. One swipe of the tag, a satisfying beep, and the gate yielded. Now I’m hauling corporate property with both hands, successfully integrated into the system. Problem is, the lift indicator is counting down. 

EVE is now logged as an anonymous escort for corporate cargo, descending deeper into the facility while the surface remains above her. 

#NeoTokyo #Archive #Logistics #Maintenance #Underground #GlitchInTheSystem #Cyberpunk
